title: Annual circularity portfolio review and trend monitoring
primary_chapter_title: Circular Health Systems and Resource Stewardship
purpose: Provides a reproducible synthetic example for annual circularity portfolio review and trend monitoring.
input: Excel wb with worksheets: Portfolio, Read_Me.
outputs: Produces the following reference outputs: annual_portfolio_summary.csv, circular_activity_trends.png, environmental_intensity_trends.png, run_metadata.json, summary.csv, summary.json.
limitations: Educational and decision-support example only. It is not a validated clinical, regulatory, legal, procurement, accreditation, cybersecurity, or health technology assessment instrument.
